messages:
anna: Kicking off ArgoMetrics POC perf validation. They want microburst recovery, per-10k token cost, and answers to the BYOK question. Need run matrix + sec checklist by EOD.

raj: Simple matrix: 1) Soak: 3k qps for 1h. 2) Burst: 15k qps for 15s x6. 3) Failover: route 25% to smaller model during a burst. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, enqueue wait, avg batch size.

dustin: Ops notes: warm caches 20m before burst; continuous batching + max_batch_ms=12; pin shards on Dedicated. Use tag `argometrics-poc`.

liz: Smoke commands (adapt to loadgen):
```
python infra/loadgen.py --mix "short:70,long:30" --prompt-len 30 --resp-len 45 --qps 3000 --duration 60m --tag argometrics-poc
python infra/loadgen.py --burst-qps 15000 --burst-duration 15 --bursts 6 --warmup 20m --out results/burst.json
```

sec-bot: Sec questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood-internal/sq/901 requires IP allowlist + BYOK option for prod. POC: BYOK preferred, HSM optional.

anna: ArgoMetrics wants rough cost sketch hosted vs dedicated per-10k tokens for this mix.

raj: Ballpark from recent runs: hosted ~$0.028 per 10k tokens under bursty mix; Dedicated reserved ~$0.014 per 10k tokens if baseline kept. We'll add burst-minute surcharge in the calc.

dustin: Note: KMS per-call adds ~6-10ms. For POC enable on-host key caching (TTL 30s) to avoid per-request roundtrips. We'll document tradeoffs in sec answers.

ops-bot: Reservation created: dh-res-77899 for 2027-02-12T10:00Z, pool=dedicated-standard-8.

anna: Next steps: Raj to post final runbook + cost calc by Tue noon. Dustin to finalize caching config. Liz to answer sec items 2.1-2.4 and confirm NDA. Smoke run Tue 10:00 UTC. Tag any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
